name: Backend Golang
description: Orchestration profile for Go backend services with a focus on concurrency safety and explicit error handling.

tools.name: golangci-lint
tools.description: Aggregated static analysis linter for Go (when used by the consumer repository).

candidate_checks.description: Run standard static analysis on Go source code.
Run all unit tests across the Go module.
Run tests with the Go data race detector enabled.

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the accepted go test / go vet commands
Valid file scope verification and clean git diff --check whitespace output
Evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Data races on shared variables or maps accessed across multiple goroutines
Goroutine leaks caused by blocked channels or missing context.Context cancellation
Ignoring returned errors (err) or misplacing resource cleanup (defer Close)
quant_escalation_required_when: Computing PnL, funding rates, liquidation, quantitative order matching, or financial risk
